title: A Clinical Study of Tranilast in the Treatment of Sarcoidosis
brief_summary: 56 patients with sarcoidosis will be selected to receive treatment of tranilast.The investigators can analyse the changes in the thickness and area of skin lesions before and after treatment as well as other involved organs nodule size changes to determine the efficacy and safety of drugs.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* (1)patients with diagnosed sarcoidosis, the skin pathology showed non necrotic granuloma and negative staining of fungi and atypical mycobacterium; (2)No corticosteroids and immunosuppressants were used for nearly 1 months.

Exclusion Criteria:

* 1)with a liver or kidney disease, or accompanied by a tumor or a severe infection ; (2)with mental disease.
